changelog:
- Initial release of agency-os: a Notion-based dispatch board and task management skill.
- Implements single entry point (`/agency-os <cmd>`) with centralized command parsing; no sub-namespace.
- Supports harness-agnostic execution with detailed rules for model selection and subagent delegation (Sonnet-by-default on Claude Code, configurable elsewhere).
- Separates source-of-truth between local files (stable specs, config) and Notion (tasks, discussion, corpus pages), with clear one-way sync rules.
- Provides standard commands for setup, workspace management, and Notion mutation via the Notion MCP tools.
summary: Manage and mutate Notion-based agency task and corpus data via slash commands using medium-reasoning Sonnet subagent for accurate dispatch board updates.
